## Ostgosh (CR 1)

The large bird raises its head, sensing your approach. It seems to be trying to determine whether to run or to attack.  

**XP** 400  
N Large animal  
**Init** +2; **Senses** low-light vision, scent; Perception +6  


**Defense**


**AC** 13, touch 13, flat-footed 9 (+4 Dex, –1 size)  
**hp** 15 (2d8+6)  
**Fort** +6, **Ref** +5, **Will** +1  


**Offense**


**Speed** 50 ft.  
**Melee** 2 talons +5 (1d4+2)  
**Space** 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 14, **Dex** 18, **Con** 12, **Int** 2, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +5; **CMD** 17  
**Feats** Endurance, Run  
**Skills** Perception +6  
**SQ** Rushing Limits  


**Special Abilities**


**Rushing Limits (Ex)** The creature is capable of breaking past it’s limits with the help of a skilled enough rider. As a swift action, a creature mounting a creature with this feature may make a modified Spur Mount check, as per the ride skill. In addition to the base movement speed added by the skill use, for every five points by which the skill check exceeds the DC 15, the mount gains an additional 10-foot bonus to it’s movement speed. This use of this ability may only be used once a day.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate plains  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or herd (3–30)  
**Treasure** none
